outbound.choose:
<when condition="@(context.Variables.ContainsKey("ccofBackendId") && context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("ccofRefusal", "x") == "")">
        
          <when condition="@(!context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("ccofStream", false) && context.Response.StatusCode == 200 && context.Response.Headers.GetValueOrDefault("Content-Type", "").Contains("application/json"))">
            <set-variable name="ccofResponseJson" value="@(context.Response.Body.As(preserveContent: true))" />
          
        
        <set-variable name="ccofUsageTrace" value="@{
            JObject usage = null;
            var servedModel = "";
            try {
                var text = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("ccofResponseJson", "");
                if (text != "") {
                    var body = JObject.Parse(text);
                    var m = body["model"];
                    if (m != null && m.Type == JTokenType.String && System.Text.RegularExpressions.Regex.IsMatch((string)m, "^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._:-]{0,119}$")) { servedModel = (string)m; }
                    var u = body["usage"] as JObject;
                    if (u != null) {
                        usage = new JObject();
                        foreach (var name in new string[] { "input_tokens", "output_tokens", "cache_read_input_tokens" }) {
                            var v = u[name];
                            usage[name] = v != null && v.Type == JTokenType.Integer && (long)v >= 0 ? new JValue((long)v) : JValue.CreateNull();
                        }
                        var created = u["cache_creation"] as JObject;
                        if (created == null) {
                            usage["cache_creation"] = JValue.CreateNull();
                        } else {
                            var counts = new JObject();
                            foreach (var name in new string[] { "ephemeral_5m_input_tokens", "ephemeral_1h_input_tokens" }) {
                                var v = created[name];
                                counts[name] = v != null && v.Type == JTokenType.Integer && (long)v >= 0 ? new JValue((long)v) : JValue.CreateNull();
                            }
                            usage["cache_creation"] = counts;
                        }
                        var geo = u["inference_geo"];
                        usage["inference_geo"] = geo != null && geo.Type == JTokenType.String && System.Text.RegularExpressions.Regex.IsMatch((string)geo, "^[a-z_]{1,32}$") ? new JValue((string)geo) : JValue.CreateNull();
                    }
                }
            } catch {
                usage = null;
                servedModel = "";
            }
            try {
                var backendId = (string)context.Variables["ccofBackendId"];
                var deployment = (string)context.Variables["ccofModel"];
                string inferenceGeo = null;
                foreach (var entry in new string[] { %%INFERENCE_GEO_ENTRIES%% }) {
                    if (entry.StartsWith(backendId + "|" + deployment + "=", StringComparison.Ordinal)) { inferenceGeo = entry.Substring(entry.IndexOf("=", StringComparison.Ordinal) + 1); }
                }
                return new JObject(
                    new JProperty("schemaVersion", 1),
                    new JProperty("requestId", context.RequestId.ToString()),
                    new JProperty("observedAt", DateTime.UtcNow.ToString("o")),
                    new JProperty("personId", (string)context.Variables["ccofOid"]),
                    new JProperty("projectId", (string)context.Variables["ccofProjectId"]),
                    new JProperty("classification", (string)context.Variables["ccofClassification"]),
                    new JProperty("classificationGroupId", (string)context.Variables["ccofClassificationGroupId"]),
                    new JProperty("classificationGroupDisplayName", context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("ccofClassificationGroupDisplayName", "") == "" ? null : (string)context.Variables["ccofClassificationGroupDisplayName"]),
                    new JProperty("modelFamily", context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("ccofModelFamily", "") == "" ? null : (string)context.Variables["ccofModelFamily"]),
                    new JProperty("backendId", backendId),
                    new JProperty("deployment", deployment),
                    new JProperty("model", servedModel),
                    new JProperty("streamed", (bool)context.Variables["ccofStream"]),
                    new JProperty("inferenceGeo", inferenceGeo),
                    new JProperty("inferenceGeoSource", inferenceGeo == null ? "unknown" : "deployment"),
                    new JProperty("usageSource", usage == null ? "log" : "body"),
                    new JProperty("usage", usage)).ToString(Newtonsoft.Json.Formatting.None);
            } catch {
                return "";
            }
        }" />

policies.on-error:
<when condition="@(context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("ccofResolverCalled", false) && !context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("ccofResolverTraced", false) && context.Variables.ContainsKey("ccofResolverOutcome"))">
        
          @{
              var budget = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault<string>("ccofResolverBudgetState", "");
              return new JObject(
                  new JProperty("schemaVersion", 1),
                  new JProperty("requestId", context.RequestId.ToString()),
                  new JProperty("observedAt", DateTime.UtcNow.ToString("o")),
                  new JProperty("resolverOutcome", (string)context.Variables["ccofResolverOutcome"]),
                  new JProperty("resolverDurationMs", context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault<long>("ccofResolverMs", 0)),
                  new JProperty("budgetState", budget == "" ? null : budget),
                  new JProperty("served", false)).ToString(Newtonsoft.Json.Formatting.None);
          }
        
      
    
    
    
    <set-variable name="ccofErrorBody" value="@{
        var kind = (string)context.Variables["ccofErrorKind"];
        var reason = context.LastError.Reason ?? "";
        var project = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("ccofProjectId", "");
        var classification = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("ccofClassification", "");
        var period = kind == "group_quota" ? context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("ccofGroupPeriod", "") : context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("ccofPersonPeriod", "");
        var unit = period == "Hourly" ? "hour" : period == "Daily" ? "day" : period == "Weekly" ? "week" : period == "Monthly" ? "month" : period == "Yearly" ? "year" : "period";
        var adjective = period == "" ? "" : period.ToLowerInvariant() + " ";
        string type = "api_error";
        string message;
        switch (kind) {
            case "jwt":
                type = "authentication_error";
                if (reason.Contains("NotPresent")) { message = "No access token was sent. Sign in to the gateway and send the token as a Bearer token in the Authorization header."; }
                else if (reason.Contains("Expired")) { message = "Your access token has expired. Sign in again to get a new one."; }
                else if (reason.Contains("Audience")) { message = "The access token is for a different application. Request a token for this gateway's API."; }
                else if (reason.Contains("Issuer") || reason.Contains("Claim")) { message = "The access token was not issued by your organisation's Microsoft Entra tenant. Sign in with your organisation account."; }
                else { message = "The access token is not valid. Sign in again."; }
                break;
            case "admission_person":
                type = "rate_limit_error";
                message = "You sent more than %%PERSON_CALLS%% requests in %%PERSON_PERIOD%% seconds. Wait for the time in the Retry-After header, then retry.";
                break;
            case "admission_resolver":
                type = "rate_limit_error";
                message = "The gateway is busy checking access. Retry in %%RETRY_AFTER%% seconds; your access has not changed.";
                break;
            case "person_rate":
                type = "rate_limit_error";
                message = "You have reached your tokens-per-minute limit for project " + project + ". Retry after the time in the Retry-After header.";
                break;
            case "person_quota":
                type = "permission_error";
                message = "Your " + adjective + "token quota for project " + project + " is used up. It resets at the start of the next " + unit + " (UTC). Your access is otherwise unchanged.";
                break;
            case "group_rate":
                type = "rate_limit_error";
                message = "The tokens-per-minute limit shared by classification " + classification + " in project " + project + " is reached. Retry after the time in the Retry-After header.";
                break;
            case "group_quota":
                type = "permission_error";
                message = "The " + adjective + "token quota shared by classification " + classification + " in project " + project + " is used up. It resets at the start of the next " + unit + " (UTC). Your own access is unchanged.";
                break;
            case "family_person_rate_exceeded":
                type = "rate_limit_error";
                message = "Your token rate limit for this model family is exceeded. Retry after the indicated interval.";
                break;
            case "family_group_rate_exceeded":
                type = "rate_limit_error";
                message = "Your group's token rate limit for this model family is exceeded. Retry after the indicated interval.";
                break;
            case "family_person_quota_exceeded":
                type = "permission_error";
                message = "Your token quota for this model family is used up for this quota period.";
                break;
            case "family_group_quota_exceeded":
                type = "permission_error";
                message = "Your group's token quota for this model family is used up for this quota period.";
                break;
            case "backend_credential":
                message = "The gateway could not get a credential for the model service. Your access is unaffected. Retry in %%RETRY_AFTER%% seconds; if this continues, tell your platform team.";
                break;
            case "backend_unreachable":
                message = "The model service could not be reached. Retry shortly.";
                break;
            case "backend_timeout":
                message = "The model service did not answer in time. Retry shortly.";
                break;
            case "not_found":
                type = "not_found_error";
                message = "This gateway does not serve the requested path or method. Check the endpoint path.";
                break;
            default:
                message = "The gateway hit an unexpected error. Retry; if this continues, tell your platform team.";
                break;
        }
        return new JObject(
            new JProperty("type", "error"),
            new JProperty("error", new JObject(
                new JProperty("type", type),
                new JProperty("message", message + " Request id: " + context.RequestId.ToString() + ".")))).ToString(Newtonsoft.Json.Formatting.None);
    }" />
